newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brasmotor, Multibras still buys.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brasmotor, Multibras still buys.

text.p: -- Banco Patrimonio/Salomon Brothers said it is maintaining its buy recommendations on Brazilian white goods firms Brasmotor, its unit Multibras and Refripar.
-- The bank also said it downgraded Brasmotor subsidiary Embraco shares.
-- Patrimonio said it has raised its 1996 earnings estimates for Brasmotor, Multibras and Refripar and reduced its projection for Embraco.
-- The bank said it raised its Brasmotor 1996 earnings projection to $102 million from $97.4 million and maintains its 1997 estimate at $103.5 million.
-- It raised its 1996 and 1997 projections for Multibras to $196 million and $195 million from $190.1 million and $194.1 million respectively.
-- The bank's 1996 Refripar estimate rose to $35.2 million from $30.2 million while its 1997 projection rose to $41.1 million from $32.4 million.
-- For Embraco, the bank reduced its 1996 estimates to $22 million from $36 million and, for 1997, to $34.2 million from $39.3 million, Patrimonio said.

-- It reduced Embraco earnings estimates and downgraded its stock due to lower sales volume, worse-than-expected equities income from affiliates and a non-operating losses this year related to the sale of former unit Motores Eletricos.
